// diagnostic

E0913

Trait impl missing associated type

What

Trait impl missing associated type

Why

An implementation names every associated type its trait declares

Fix

Add the missing associated type to the trait implementation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0913: tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingAssociatedType]: `impl …: Container` doesn't set `type Item`
  --> tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.jet:9:10
    |
  9 |     impl Container {
    |          ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Container` declares an associated type each impl must define
 Fix: Add `type Item = …` inside the impl block
